mission.title: n8n: Clicking on a folder with N8N_PATH and N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL set causes 404
mission.description: Clicking on a folder with N8N_PATH and N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL set causes 404. Requested by 7+ users.

steps.title: Check current n8n deployment
steps.description:
Verify your n8n version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n n8n -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n
helm list -n n8n 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working n8n installation.

steps.title: Review n8n configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant n8n configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n n8n -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n
kubectl get configmap -n n8n -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=n8n
```
### Bug Description

If I have N8N_PATH and N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL environment variables set, then, when I click on a folder, it causes a 404.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Clicking on a folder with N8N_PATH and N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL…
steps.description:
## Summary

Instances relying on `BASE_PATH` need this path on the client to fetch `/{basePath}/rest/config.js`. This PR is a hotfix to give the client access to `BASE_PATH` until we drop this feature in v2.

## Related Linear tickets, Github issues, and Community forum posts

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n n8n -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n
kubectl get events -n n8n --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Clicking on a folder with N8N_PATH and N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:

Instances relying on `BASE_PATH` need this path on the client to fetch `/{basePath}/rest/config.js`. This PR is a hotfix to give the client access to `BASE_PATH` until we drop this feature in v2.
